description: Configure for zone joint usage. This command should be given before the zone joint create command. This command sets small strain mode and assigns the Mohr Model model as the default contact model in the Contact Model Assignment Table (CMAT) .
notes: Documented in the 'wad' (wall-and-discontinuity) doc tree, not under flac3d/ -- which is why this family is absent from the FLAC zone corpus.
Live-probed on MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14). Availability in FLAC3D is unverified.

WARNING: running 'zone joint configure' also issues 'model large-strain off' and installs a default vertex-facet contact model. Large-strain off freezes positions, so re-assert 'model large-strain on' afterwards if you need motion. (state)
